This is where water clarifying agents like these AquaPacs can help. They bind up these smaller particles into larger conglomerates that are more easily pulled from the water by the filter. How to do a water change🫧  This was the first water change after my betta moved in last week.  Step 1: unplug the heater, light, filter Step 2: siphon the substrate/ground Step 3: drain approx. 1/3 of the water  Step 4: dechlorinate the fresh water and fill up the aquarium Step 5: wipe the rim, edges, outside of the tank Step 6: feed your betta and show them some love.
